Try a 20‑minute garlic‑ginger chicken stir‑fry: slice 1 lb chicken breast, toss with 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp cornstarch; sauté with minced garlic, ginger, broccoli florets, bell‑pepper strips; finish with a splash of sesame oil; serve over instant rice or noodles.
